relationship_to_existing_endpoints.rule: This is a new temporal-axis empirical lane on an independent camera-trap dataset. No result can promote, repair or reinterpret the completed bat or Tawaki endpoints.

question: Do mammal identities partition camera-detected time within the same sites, and does species-conditioned temporal organization transfer to independently held-out camera sites?

source.time_semantics: DateTime is source-reported Tanzania local clock time UTC+3 with no daylight saving time
source.effort_semantics: search_effort.csv gives camera-valid start/end dates; camera-day effort is used to prevent long-running sites from dominating

frozen_preprocessing.site_weight: each retained event receives weight 1 / merged valid camera-days at its SiteID

primary_estimands.temporal_partition: I(C;T|Site), where C is admitted species identity
primary_estimands.heldout_transferability: for each of three held-out site folds, E_heldout[log P_model(T|C)-log P_model(T)]

null_and_scoring.conditional_partition_null: permute admitted species labels among retained events within SiteID, preserving site-specific species counts and observed time schedule
null_and_scoring.generalizing_rule: I(C;T|Site) permutation p <= 0.05 AND every independent held-out site-fold temporal gain > 0
null_and_scoring.mixed_rule: partition detected but held-out gains have mixed signs
null_and_scoring.non_generalizing_rule: partition detected but all held-out gains <= 0

claim_ceiling: Camera-detected temporal partition is not automatically true activity-time niche partition because time-varying detection can remain.
Clock-time partition is not solar-time partition and no sunrise/sunset correction is added post hoc.
I(C;T|Site) is descriptive conditional association, not evidence that one species causes temporal displacement of another.
Positive transfer across camera-site folds does not establish cross-region, cross-season or cross-dataset generality.
Negative or unavailable outcomes are terminal scientific results and must not trigger bin, species-threshold, pseudocount or dataset retuning.
